integrity: A reproducible finite checker independently evaluates the modal formula and relational inclusions. Asymptotic laws are proved using uniform joint-absence bounds and factorial moments; priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Independent Bernoulli off-diagonal reflexive Kripke relations only; no arbitrary product-structure, dependent-edge, or infinite-frame assertion; finite exhaustive checks do not establish asymptotic claims.
title: Two Poisson windows for saturation of mixed modal relations
